issue.title: GUI: 切换协议标签页后 Anthropic baseURL 被改成 /v1beta
issue.body:
**问题**
在 provider 编辑页，先给 `Anthropic 兼容` 填写 `https://xxx/v1`，检测后一开始还是对的。但当我点过其他协议标签页后，再打开这个 provider，`Anthropic 兼容` 变成了 `https://xxx/v1beta`。

`/v1beta` 是 Gemini 的规范化行为，不是 Anthropic 的。后端对 Anthropic 只会去掉尾部 `/v1` 或 `/v1/messages`，不会补 `/v1beta`。

**复现**
1. 新增 custom provider
2. `Anthropic 兼容` 填 `https://xxx/v1`
3. 检测或保存
4. 依次点击其他协议标签页
5. 再次打开 provider，Anthropic 被改成 `https://xxx/v1beta`

**预期**
各协议的 base URL 应互不干扰；切换标签页或重新检测不应把 Gemini 的规范化结果写入 Anthropic 字段。

**环境**
- OS: Windows

comments.body:
Implemented in the fork:
- URL fix: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/9f7ada4f
- Test save-completion follow-up: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/9829acc
- Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/provider-protocol-url

Consecutive tab switches were converting the previously converted URL: an unsaved Anthropic `https://host/v1` became Gemini's `/v1beta`, then came back with that suffix. Each switch now restores the original input before choosing the next destination. Returning to the original protocol restores the exact input. Typing a different URL after several switches restores the first URL to its original protocol, so both can be saved. Saved endpoints and taken detection results retain independent URLs. The existing “type a URL, then choose its protocol” behavior (#73/#105) is preserved.

The retained regression fails against the old implementation with `/v1beta` instead of `/v1`. It covers round trips through all protocols, saving/reopening, typing a second address after consecutive switches, and detection controls. The fixture is a simulated backend; it does not make vendor requests.

Combined verification at https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/c61bf9b7315a12ccde15e0b6ef393f5e51771019: Go 1.26.8, umask 027, isolated HOME with caches pinned; native/Linux nogui/Windows vet and builds passed, and `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m` passed (69 packages passed, 19 have no tests). Windows validation is cross-vet/build; native Windows/macOS runtimes were not exercised.

The initial expanded browser run also exposed a test navigation race: a recorded save POST was read before its subsequent state refresh finished. The follow-up waits for the editor to close and show save success before navigating; the initial failure log is retained. An adjacent Detect APIs dialog-position failure is tracked separately, not counted as a fix here.

Final URL regression: Chromium/WebKit × all five languages × 900/440px passed 20/20, with remote app/test SHA-256 matching the committed tree. Old assets fail the round-trip assertion in both engines. The unrelated held-dialog failure is now tracked in #3309; it remains unfixed. The related four other browser files passed their 22 cases.
